marketing.heroSub: Personalized nutrition coaching that fits your life.
marketing.aboutSub: Your guide to sustainable, science-backed health.
marketing.aboutBioLong: Dr. Rawan Othman brings a fresh, evidence-based approach to nutrition that goes beyond generic diets. In her 3 years of specialized practice, she has helped hundreds of clients transform their relationship with food — building sustainable habits that fit real life, not just theory.
marketing.servicesHeadline: Online nutrition coaching, built around you.
marketing.service1Body: Weekly video consultations with a certified clinical nutritionist. Personalized guidance, real accountability, and adjustments tailored to your progress.
marketing.service2Title: Custom Meal Plans by a Registered Nutritionist
marketing.service2Body: Personalized meal plans built around your dietary preferences, food allergies, and lifestyle. Updated weekly to match your weight loss and wellness goals.
marketing.service3Body: Snap any meal to instantly track calories, macros, and micronutrients. AI-powered scanning paired with clinical nutrition expertise for accurate, evidence-based insights.
marketing.service4Body: Clinically-vetted vitamins and supplements selected by certified nutritionists. Evidence-based quality, member discounts, and free shipping on every order.
marketing.reviewsSub: From clients who let us into their kitchens.
marketing.communitySub: A private community of clients walking the same road.
marketing.communityLockedBody: Real client stories, weekly progress shares, and expert tips from our nutrition team — open to all members.
marketing.storeSub: Supplements clinically vetted for real results.
marketing.bookingSub: Book a free 20-minute intro call — no commitment, no pressure.
marketing.review1Quote: Dr. Rawan's plan changed how I think about food. I lost 8 kg in 3 months — and kept it off.
marketing.review2Quote: The food scanner is incredible. I finally understand exactly what I'm eating before every meal.
marketing.review3Quote: After years of failed diets, Dr. Rawan gave me a plan that actually fits my life.
marketing.drPostBody: Quick reminder — hydration before caffeine. A glass of water in the first 20 minutes of your day moves the needle more than people realize.
marketing.footerTagline: Personalized nutrition coaching, built around you.
